pricing.title: Start free. Upgrade when you publish every week.
pricing.description: Pro runs in Stripe test mode: this is a demo, and no real money changes hands.

free.question: Is it free?
free.answer: Yes. A free account includes 5 generations a month, and a guest session 3 in total. Pro adds 100 a month, every length and the stronger model — in test mode, so nothing is charged.

account.question: Do I need an account?
account.answer: Not to try it. The demo on this page runs without one, and a guest session gives you the whole app. Create an account when you want to keep your work — your guest content comes with you.

sample.question: What is Sample mode?
sample.answer: When no AI key is configured, or the daily budget is used up, Fanout streams pre-written sample content through exactly the same interface. It is always labelled “Sample output”, so you never mistake it for real output.

ai.question: Which AI writes the content?
ai.answer: Claude, by Anthropic. Free and guest generations use a fast model; Pro uses a stronger one.

billing.question: Will I be charged for Pro?
billing.answer: No. Billing runs in Stripe test mode. Use the card 4242 4242 4242 4242 to see the whole subscription flow without paying anything.

serbian.question: Can it write in Serbian?
serbian.answer: Yes, in Latin script and in a natural register. The content language is chosen separately from the interface language.

publishing.question: Does it post to social networks?
publishing.answer: It publishes to your own email inbox and to Discord channels. For LinkedIn, Instagram and X you copy the finished piece — each one is already in that platform's shape.

data.question: Who can see what I write?
data.answer: Only you. Every piece is stored behind row-level security in the database, and Discord webhook addresses are never shown back in full.
